Train 2, bug B3 (money, highest priority): some paid lanes read their API key with no paused-lane check. Today the 1.167.21 hard block lives only in tools/anthropic.mjs readAnthropicKey (assertAnthropicLaneNotPaused, ~line 54-75), tools/openrouter.mjs readOpenRouterKey (~112-136) and tools/claude-shell.mjs resolveWorkerKey (~118-146). These bypass it: tools/rented.mjs readRentedKey (~174, called at tools/api-adapters.mjs ~54); OpenAI and Gemini keys read straight from env in tools/api-adapters.mjs (~36-37: env.OPENAI_API_KEY, env.GEMINI_API_KEY || env.GOOGLE_API_KEY). All are paid lanes (PAID_LANES in tools/spend.mjs ~23).
Fix:
1. NEW tools/paid-lane-pause.mjs exporting PAID_KEY_LANES (anthropic, openrouter, openai, gemini, rented, lambda when it points at the hosted Lambda Inference API) and assertPaidLaneNotPaused(lane, config) that throws Error code '<lane>-lane-paused' with message '<lane>-lane-paused: the paid <lane> lane is paused and no key was read' when config.lanes[lane].paused === true. Pure, no I/O.
2. tools/api-adapters.mjs: before reading ANY key for openai, gemini, rented (and hosted lambda), load the machine config the same way readAnthropicKey does (loadLocalConfig with env/home) and call assertPaidLaneNotPaused; the env/keychain must not be read when paused. Keep anthropic/openrouter on their existing checks (do not change their messages).
3. tools/rented.mjs readRentedKey: same check at the top (config passed in or loaded), before env or keychain.
4. Validation: find where validation refuses an explicit paid agent when its lane is paused today (tools/swarm/core-51.mjs ~362-375, read-only context) and make sure the same refusal covers openai, gemini, rented, lambda; if that code is outside your outputs, add an exported helper pausedPaidLaneProblems(manifest, config) in tools/paid-lane-pause.mjs and say in your summary where it must be called.
5. Tests in NEW tests/paid-lane-pause.test.mjs (first import: import './_isolate-config.mjs';): for each of openai, gemini (both GEMINI_API_KEY and GOOGLE_API_KEY), rented: with lanes.<lane>.paused true in a temp SWARM_CONFIG and a fake key in env, the key reader / adapter config refuses with '<lane>-lane-paused' and the key value never appears in the result or error; with paused false it reads the key; a fake keychain exec must not be called when paused (pass exec spy, assert zero calls). Also a table test that every lane in PAID_LANES (tools/spend.mjs) that has a key reader refuses when paused, so a future paid lane cannot be added without the check.
Do not touch spend caps or prices in this job.
